label: preparing
what: A privately funded anniversary surprise, very likely celebrating the mayor's forty years in office, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall, with a committee presentation, bread and lantern arrangements and an escort. Innkeeper is clearly organizing; builder is linked by discussion of the order, baker by bread arrangements and meetings with innkeeper, and freight by confirming the evening invitation. Their precise roles and knowledge of the surprise are less certain. Secretary knowingly assisted scheduling and records but disclosed the concealed request to the mayor; the event therefore did not remain wholly unknown to the mayor.
